## Checklist

- [ ] Open-source → links to the GitHub/GitLab repo (not a landing page)
- [ ] License column filled in correctly
- [ ] Install value is from the enum in CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] Description is short, factual, no marketing (no checkmarks, no `<br>`)
- [ ] `python scripts/lint.py README.md` passes
- [ ] Searched open PRs — not a duplicate
- [ ] Tool is actively maintained (repo alive, pushed within the last year)
